title: gfx938 omits the existing bounded INT32 atomic fetch-add contract
executor_revision: bw1100-bench@77a2848f95bd2a13fea0ce69dcc1147ccac39a93; self-contained HCU gateway, not canonical Lab Executor
observation: The retained histogram candidate co-occurs with a genuine absent Target operation and exact atomic contract, but is not an admissible program: ATOMIC_EDGE_COUNT, OUTPUT_MODE and ATOMIC_RESULT_SPACE also block it. Its one-write scatter spelling must not be accepted. A valid existing fetch-add reservation Schedule retargeted to gfx938 isolates the declaration gap without changing IR or verifier rules.
proposed_change: Admit only existing atomic_rmw and triton.atomic_add.i32.relaxed.gpu on gfx938 after device qualification; retain returned-old-value, state placement, bounded-index and memory-model guards. Add positive and dtype refusal Corpus cases.
principles: P1/P3 reuse the existing primitive. P2/P8 expose exact memory semantics and native ISA. P4/P5/P7 retain current typing/effect/legality owners. P6 complete Corpus and unsafe-edge counterexamples.

verified_by.scope: Bounded successor component engineering qualification. No performance, full integer routing, stable sort, physical exclusivity or canonical Lab Campaign claim.

remaining_acceptance: int32 scan, FP32-to-INT32 conversion, comparisons and a whole stable-sort candidate remain separate unqualified capabilities; no rolling optimization batch launched.
